title: PLAN Product Repository Repair Boundary
stopConditions: Project Control cannot identify the agent-and-skill-design Work path, owner repository, active role, Checklist target, or Evidence target before editing.
The phase edits Core, Backend, or Editor product behavior while tightening PLAN room responsibilities.
The wording allows PLAN to patch product repositories directly after dispatch when a same-room WORK Revision Packet is possible.
The wording treats PLAN diagnosis, merge, verification, Project Control records, or cleanup as permission to change product repository files.
The new boundary hides the first-delivery Backend PLAN-side repair as acceptable practice instead of recording it as a boundary breach risk.
verificationTarget: PLAN must not patch Core, Backend, or Editor product repositories after dispatch; if product-repository repair is needed, PLAN may diagnose and attach failure evidence, then product-repository repair goes back to the same WORK room as a Revision Packet when the original retrievable locator remains usable; only merge, verification, Project Control records, and cleanup that do not change product repository files or product behavior remain PLAN-owned exceptions.
summary: Done: tightened the PLAN/WORK operating contract after the first-delivery Backend verification repair showed that PLAN can over-carry product repository repair. Future PLAN rooms must send product-repository repair back to the same WORK room as a Revision Packet instead of patching Core, Backend, or Editor directly after dispatch.
